angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 497,426 km at 158.74 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.2997 +/- 0.0150 mas (same row, RUWE 1.02): 158.74 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.715 +/- 0.043 solar radii from Howard et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-55 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract): 497,426 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.688 +/- 0.069 solar masses from Howard et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-55 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4300 +/- 107 K from Howard et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-55 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Howard et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-55 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-55.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.567, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, K2-55: main object type LM*, Low-mass Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-55 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.376 dex, from Howard et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-55 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.78432, from Barros et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016A&A...594A.100B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-55 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.2 km/s, from Howard et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
